Package com.pos

package com.pos
Sharetea's JavaFX point-of-sale interface and PostgreSQL-backed manager reports. Main starts the cashier and manager tabs; Database supplies JDBC connections that callers must close. Menu recipes connect sales quantities to estimated inventory consumption.
Author:
Humaid Syed
